title: The Genus of Bipartite Kneser Graphs
summary: We determine the orientable genus of an infinite family of bipartite Kneser graphs. The graph $H(h,2)$ has two copies of the two-element subsets of $[h]$, with opposite-class vertices adjacent when the corresponding subsets are disjoint. For every prime $h>3$ with $h\equiv3\pmod8$, we prove $$ γ(H(h,2))=1-\frac{h(h-1)}{2} +\frac{h(h-1)(h-2)(h-3)}{16}. $$ Euler's formula gives this lower bound, with equality for a quadrangulation.
